tagline: Thank you for your purchase. Pick a colour theme below - your tracker is two clicks away.
excel_note: Prefer Excel? The .xlsx files are included in your download and open in Excel 2016 or later.
steps: Sign in to your Google account, then click a button above and choose “Make a copy”. The copy is yours alone.
Open the My Debts tab. List each debt with its balance, interest rate (APR) and minimum payment.
Open the Payoff Plan tab. Choose Snowball, Avalanche or My order, and type what extra you can pay each month.
Each time you pay, add a row on the Payment Log tab: date, debt, amount.
When a statement arrives, type its balance in “Balance after” so interest is counted.
tips: Yellow cells are yours to type in. Pale yellow cells are optional or filled in for you.
Want to see it working first? Open a sample-data copy and explore.
The forecast is a plan based on fixed rates and minimum payments. It is not financial advice.
terms: For personal use by one household. Please do not share, resell or redistribute this file or its links.
support: Questions? Message the shop on Etsy and we will help.
